findings.body: `summarize` always emits `LIMIT 25000` and then validates that SQL against `config.maxRows`. The unchanged default is 1,000 (`backend/src/config.ts:188`), and `SqlValidator` rejects any larger limit (`backend/src/sql/sqlValidator.ts:66`). Consequently, deployments using the normal/default configuration cannot execute the required issuance summary at all. Bound the SQL by the number of requested rows and the configured maximum instead of hard-coding 25,000.
findings.title: Not done: Make the issuance summary respect the configured row limit

findings.body: This condition refuses any unknown filter dimension or empty array. However, the executed answer path preserves unknown filters (`backend/src/chat/chat.service.ts:674`) and `SqlBuilder` silently ignores them (`backend/src/sql/sqlBuilder.ts:97`); empty array-valued `eq`/`neq` filters are likewise valid and ignored. Such a selection can therefore produce and sign a valid answer, but its drill returns “cannot be opened” instead of re-deriving the answer predicate. The drill must share the answer query's ignore semantics or those shapes must be rejected before answer execution.
findings.title: Not done: Re-derive filters that the answer query ignores

findings.body: The new operator matrix only compares whether the literal `2026-06-01` occurs in both SQL strings. Replacing the drill's `neq` operator with `=` would still leave the literal present and the test green, even though the drill predicate no longer matches the answer predicate. This is a hollow proof of the required predicate re-derivation; assert the actual predicate/operator semantics for each case.

findings.body: This branch still only registers and exports the signing seam. No Ask response invokes the summary/signing service or emits `AskResponse.drill`, and no Actual cell calls the route. The story assigns issuance to GL-ANSWER-WIRING and the user interaction to GL-DRILL-PANEL, so this remains expected deferred work rather than a blocker for this prerequisite task.
